## Checklist

- [ ] I reconciled the control profile, active milestone, authority, and status first.
- [ ] The change is one bounded evidence unit and stays inside its authority envelope.
- [ ] Repository validation and relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] Real outputs were inspected where this change has a rendered or runtime surface.
- [ ] No frozen protocol, evaluation evidence, or claim boundary was silently changed.
- [ ] Roadmap, status, changelog, version history, evidence ledger, and devlog are current where applicable.
- [ ] Publication or release claims are backed by independently verified live state.
